description: Convert a Word (.docx) file to GitHub-flavored Markdown. Returns the Markdown plus any document warnings (encryption, sensitivity labels, content that could not be converted). Only .docx is supported; re-save older .doc files as .docx first.

image_dir.description: Extract images into this folder and link them from the Markdown. A relative folder inside output_path's folder when set, else the .docx's. Omit to drop images.

output_path.description: Write the Markdown to this .md file instead of returning it. Useful for long documents.

overwrite.description: Replace output_path or image files that already exist. Off by default, so a conversion never clobbers a file by accident.

path.description: Path to the .docx file. Relative paths resolve against the server's working directory, so prefer an absolute path.

preserve_footnotes.description: Keep footnotes as raw <sup> links instead of GFM [^1] footnotes.

name: convert_docx_to_markdown

markdown.description: The Markdown, unless output_path was set.

title: Convert Word to Markdown
